as_told.title: Dr. Eric Wang's Department of Special Studies moves to Sandia
as_told.place_text: Wright-Patterson AFB, Ohio; Sandia/Kirtland AFB, New Mexico

plain: Michels says a man named Eric Henry Wang ran special projects at Wright-Patterson, a US Air Force airfield, and was later moved to Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico, probably, Michels thinks, to work on exotic flight technology. In one telling he adds that in 1956 Wang's department was moved to the Sandia Laboratory complex at Kirtland, citing Wang's obituary in a mechanical engineering magazine and a writer named William Steinman. Michels raises it across several episodes, once alongside the inventor Viktor Schauberger, as a clue to where unusual flight research may have gone.
